lines.sub: If you've ever promoted an affiliate product, you know the problem.

This is the opposite.
A real product, built for real industries, with a full kit for every one of them, written from the actual product files.
Let me open the box.
ProfitIQS makes business intelligence systems in Excel, each one built for one industry.
Twenty-one industries. Three editions each. Sixty-three products in total.

The owner enters their own numbers. The formulas do the rest.
It ships with sample data, so every dashboard works the moment it's opened.
And every edition includes a Quick Start and a full Field Guide.

Essential is ninety-seven dollars. Elite, one ninety-seven. Complete, both editions, two forty-nine.
One payment. No subscription. It runs in the desktop version of Microsoft Excel.
Here's why owners actually want this.
Small-business owners are busy every day, and still not sure what they kept.
The data exists, in invoices, receipts, bank statements and apps, but it's never in one place.
So a plumber can't see which callbacks are eating the margin.
ProfitIQS gives him a Callback Tracker, and a Job Profitability Center.
A restaurant owner doesn't know where prime cost landed.
ProfitIQS gives her a Prime Cost Center, and Menu Intelligence for every dish.
A landlord can't tell which property is dragging the portfolio down.
ProfitIQS gives him cap rate, cash-on-cash and DSCR, property by property.
A dental practice presents treatment that never gets accepted.
ProfitIQS gives it a Case Acceptance Center, a Recall Tracker, and provider productivity.
And an owner-operator puts on busy miles, and still isn't sure which loads actually paid.
ProfitIQS gives him profit on every load, and his real cost per mile.
That's the pattern across all twenty-one industries: a real problem the owner already feels, and a real sheet that answers it.
Which matters to you, because problems like these are what people actually stop scrolling for.
Four things make ProfitIQS easier to promote than most.
One: every product is built for one industry. Match the niche to your audience, and the message almost writes itself.
Two: three price points. You can recommend Essential to a one-truck operation, and Elite to a growing team, honestly.
Three: it's a one-time payment, not a subscription. That's an easy yes to explain.
And four: the sample data means you can screen-record a working dashboard on day one, without entering a single real number.

And every kit tells you who you're talking to. The owner-operator who does the books at night. The growing company with several crews and no side-by-side view. The office manager who tracks it all for the owner.
Now, the commission. Here's the planned schedule.

From the seventeenth of January to the sixteenth of April, twenty twenty-seven: eighty-five percent.

And watch for the phase changes, on the seventeenth of January and the seventeenth of April.

You promote a ProfitIQS product with your own Digistore24 affiliate link.
A customer buys through your link.

And here's the good news: every ProfitIQS product is approved on the Digistore24 marketplace. So you can start promoting right now.
Now the part most programs don't give you. A complete kit, for every one of the twenty-one niches.

A tier comparison, so you can recommend the right edition honestly.

The commission guide. The brand messaging guide. The compliance guide. Shared recruiting copy. A launch checklist. A cold-email playbook. And a full brand asset inventory, with every real checkout link for all sixty-three editions.
Here's how to launch, step by step.
Pick the niche your audience already lives in. HVAC content to HVAC contractors converts better, and it's more honest, than everything to everyone.

There are twenty-one to choose from: ten ninety-nine contractors, Airbnb hosts, auto repair shops, cleaning services, construction, dental practices, digital marketing agencies, ecommerce, electrical contractors, HVAC, pest control, landscaping, lawn care, manufacturing, plumbing, property management, rental property, restaurants, roofing, small businesses, and trucking owner-operators.
Read that niche's product facts and tier comparison.
Pick your hooks, scripts, posts and emails, and download the graphics.
Sign in to Digistore24, find the product, and copy your affiliate link for the right niche and edition.
Check the page: it opens the right product, it loads on mobile, and the prices match.
Test your link once, from a private browser window. Don't buy through your own link to test it.
Then publish, with a clear disclosure in every post, email and video.
And check your clicks, sales and refunds weekly. Keep what works. Drop what doesn't.
If you use email, there are two lanes, and the kit keeps them separate.
Your own list gets the email swipes, and only people who opted in.
Cold outreach to business owners gets its own playbook, and its own setup: separate sending domains, a verified list, proper authentication, and weeks of warm-up before a single cold email.
Plus the legal basics, like a real postal address and a working opt-out in every message.
And the rules that keep all of this working.
Disclose clearly, right next to your link, and say it in your videos.
Describe the product honestly: an Excel system that needs desktop Excel.
No fake reviews or testimonials. No income or results claims, for buyers or for affiliates.
If you bought and used the product yourself, you can share your own honest experience.
No spam, no impersonating ProfitIQS or Digistore24, and no bidding on the ProfitIQS brand name in paid search.
No discounts, bonuses or guarantees that ProfitIQS hasn't approved.
And no claims of integrations, automation or AI. The products don't have them, and that's fine.
If you're ever unsure, leave it out, or ask.
A few honest answers before you start.
Is the ninety percent for life? No. It's the planned launch rate, then eighty-five, then eighty. Nothing in the kit promises a rate locked for life.
Is it approved on the Digistore24 marketplace? Yes. Every product is approved, so you can start promoting today.
Can I offer a discount or a bonus? Only if it's on the sales page, or ProfitIQS approved it in writing.
And who looks after the customer? ProfitIQS handles product support. Digistore24 processes the orders, payments and refunds.
So here's your next step.
Ask the ProfitIQS team for your Affiliate Hub link. Email support at profitiqs dot com, with "Affiliate" in the subject line.
Pick your niche, open the kit, and promote something you can actually stand behind.
ProfitIQS. Real products. Real kits. Honest promotion.
